notes.title: v1.04
notes.content:
v1.04 is live!

Force DirectSound for Windows7 64bit
More debugging logs

If you have any issues with this build, please let us know via the forums. 

Also by popular demand we have released an Android version of Chef Solitaire USA TriPeaks, available on the Google Play Store:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.therevillsgames.csusatripeaks

Cheers, 
Steve and Kylie
